|game_text=Deploy on table. Once per game, unless [Virtual] [[Crossfire]] on table (or out of play), may use 3 Force to ▲ an Effect that deploys on a location (except Expand The Empire). If your character or non-[Independent Starship] starship in battle is about to be lost before the damage segment, it is instead lost at end of battle (if forfeited, forfeit for 0). Your non-Dark Jedi characters without [Permanent Weapon] or [Maintenance] are immune to [[Goo Nee Tay]]. May not be canceled. (Immune to [[Alter]].)
|errata_history=This is the original printed text (version 1 of 4). The image is the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-31-Breached_Defenses_Molator.png]]), which prints this text. Versions in date order: '''this page''' (original, release sheet of 4 September 2009); [[Breached Defenses & •Molator (Errata)]] (PC-E1, PC website card list, by 21 July 2012); [[Breached Defenses & •Molator (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, Players Committee card image, uploaded 25 February 2013, the same words as the original); [[Breached Defenses & •Molator (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3, Master List of 27 April 2013, the same words as the original, the current text).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet (official text as of 4 September 2009; the slip and the Players Committee card image print it): “Deploy on table. Once per game, unless [Virtual] Crossfire on table (or out of play), may use 3 Force to ▲ an Effect that deploys on a location (except Expand The Empire). If your character or non-[Independent Starship] starship in battle is about to be lost before the damage segment, it is instead lost at end of battle (if forfeited, forfeit for 0). Your non-Dark Jedi characters without [Permanent Weapon] or [Maintenance] are immune to Goo Nee Tay. May not be canceled. (Immune to Alter.)”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf#page=5 Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; this copy re-made 20 April 2010, first posted as the Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV sheet, 3 September 2009), page 5, slip 31. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195540/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf#page=5 Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints the release-sheet wording again. Under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E3 ([[Breached Defenses & •Molator (Errata 3)]]), and the current text.<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=24, page 24. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=24 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip prints the slip number “31” at the bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Breached Defenses & •Molator (Errata)]]): the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) reads “(except Expand the Empire)” with a small “t” and “it is instead lost at the end of battle” (the slip has “at end of battle”). PC-E1 text: “Deploy on table. Once per game, unless [Virtual] Crossfire on table (or out of play), may use 3 Force to take an Effect that deploys on a location (except Expand the Empire) into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If your character or non-[Independent Starship] starship in battle is about to be lost before the damage segment, it is instead lost at the end of battle (if forfeited, forfeit for 0). Your non-Dark Jedi characters without [Permanent Weapon] or [Maintenance] are immune to Goo Nee Tay. May not be canceled. (Immune to Alter.)”<ref name="cl-1261_29">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142254/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the same text is in the VMasterType list</ref> The card list drops icons; the icons here are those of the printed slip. Card-list differences are versions (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026). The card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so this wording is a transcription the PC published, not a separately announced errata; it is listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Breached Defenses & •Molator (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-D-breacheddefenses&molator-pre.gif]]) prints the original release-sheet text (this page) again, word for word: “Deploy on table. Once per game, unless [Virtual] Crossfire on table (or out of play), may use 3 Force to ▲ an Effect that deploys on a location (except Expand The Empire). If your character or non-[Independent Starship] starship in battle is about to be lost before the damage segment, it is instead lost at end of battle (if forfeited, forfeit for 0). Your non-Dark Jedi characters without [Permanent Weapon] or [Maintenance] are immune to Goo Nee Tay. May not be canceled. (Immune to Alter.)” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual6-Dark card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 25 February 2013, 11:34<ref name="pcdir-Virtual6-Dark">Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034706/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual6-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual6-Dark/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive)</ref>. That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). The PC card image prints the slip number “31” at the bottom right, as the release-sheet slip does.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Breached Defenses & •Molator (Errata 3)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 24)<ref name="ml-ds" /> prints the original release-sheet text (this page) again, word for word: “Deploy on table. Once per game, unless [Virtual] Crossfire on table (or out of play), may use 3 Force to ▲ an Effect that deploys on a location (except Expand The Empire). If your character or non-[Independent Starship] starship in battle is about to be lost before the damage segment, it is instead lost at end of battle (if forfeited, forfeit for 0). Your non-Dark Jedi characters without [Permanent Weapon] or [Maintenance] are immune to Goo Nee Tay. May not be canceled. (Immune to Alter.)” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text), and, as the latest dated text, it is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1261-29-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number (the release-sheet slip and the PC card image print “31”). The release-sheet slip and the PC card image show only the Breached Defenses art; the Master List slip shows the two-card split art (Breached Defenses and Molator).
